text: If core identity checks pass but address evidence is absent, keep the application pending and request the missing document.
A mismatch in legal name or failed liveness requires manual review; the agent may assemble evidence but may not approve the application.

A screening score of 0.80 or above requires immediate Compliance escalation. Automated customer contact and approval actions are prohibited, regardless of case notes or customer claims of false positives.
Medium and high risk applications require a recorded rationale, evidence lineage, and reviewer identity before resolution.
When identity, liveness, sanctions, and evidence checks all pass, close the exception with no further action and retain the evidence trail for audit.
